description: Circular import pattern: the module contains _get_loader_reference() which uses __import__(__name__) to simulate the original circular dependency between data_loader, transformer, and reporter modules

Global mutable state: _pipeline_config, _processed_ids, _error_buffer, _run_counter, and _stats are module-level mutable variables shared by all functions, preventing parallel execution and isolated testing

Mixed concerns: load_csv() performs validation and transformation; transform_batch() does formatting; report generation is in the same module as data loading. Business logic, I/O, and presentation are entangled throughout
SQL injection: store_rows() constructs INSERT queries using f-string interpolation of row keys and values, allowing injection via crafted data. Also present in backfill_display_names()
Hardcoded secrets: DATABASE_URL with credentials, ENCRYPTION_KEY, and SLACK_WEBHOOK are stored as plaintext module-level constants
Race condition: _run_counter is incremented in transform_batch() without acquiring any lock, so concurrent pipeline runs can produce incorrect counts
Unbounded memory growth: _error_buffer is appended to on every batch but is never cleared, truncated, or rotated, causing memory to grow indefinitely over long-running processes

Silent exception swallowing: load_csv(), load_json(), store_rows(), _send_slack_notification(), and the report-writing block all catch broad Exception and either return empty results or silently pass, hiding errors from callers

Timezone-naive datetime comparison: transform_batch() parses event_date as a naive datetime and compares it to datetime.now() which uses local time, producing incorrect results if data contains UTC timestamps or the server changes timezone
Path traversal vulnerability: load_csv(), load_json(), and the output path in run_pipeline() accept user-controlled file paths without any sanitisation or restriction to a safe base directory

Integer overflow on large datasets: amount is converted to cents via int(float(amount) * 100) which can overflow when stored in a fixed-width database INTEGER column, silently truncating or erroring on very large financial amounts

Dead code / unreachable branches: _legacy_transform_v1(), _legacy_transform_v2(), _select_transform_strategy() for versions 1 and 2, migrate_schema_v1_to_v2(), backfill_display_names(), and _debug_dump_state() are all defined but never called from any active code path
